effects.name: Reeded Glass
effects.brief:
LOOK: the logo seen through fluted/reeded glass. Each flute is a cylindrical lens, so the logo breaks into parallel strips, each showing a magnified, shifted slice with bright flute edges. This is Studio 2am's signature 2024–26 look.
BUILD (≤1024 working res): along an axis rotated by angle, u = ((x·cosθ + y·sinθ) mod flute)/flute. Displace perpendicular to the flutes by d = (u−0.5)·flute·strength·k, with an extra per-strip magnification of 1+0.15·strength about each strip centre, and sample src with sampleBilinear. Dispersion: sample R at d·(1+disp·0.08) and B at d·(1−disp·0.08). Alpha comes from the displaced src, so the silhouette visibly splits.
SHADING: per flute, lighten the u≈0.1 edge by 0.25 and darken u≈0.9; draw a 1 px white spec line per flute at 35% alpha; add a soft vertical gloss gradient.
PANEL: optional rounded rect over the logo bbox (+8%) as frosted glass (white 10–14% alpha, fbm frost, 1 px light rim) so the effect reads on any garment.
PARAMS: flute (12–80 px, 32), strength (0–100%, 55), pattern (select straight|wave|ripple|grid; wave bends flutes with a sine, ripple uses concentric rings around the centre, grid applies flutes on both axes = glass block), angle (0–180°, 90), dispersion (0–100%, 30), panel (toggle, true).
PRESETS: Reeded (straight, 32), Wave glass (wave, 40), Ripple (ripple, 28, dispersion 50), Glass block (grid, 56, panel on).

effects.name: Liquid Glass
inspiredBy: Liquid Glass Overlay / Clarity Glass Overlay
effects.brief:
LOOK: the logo as a thick clear glass/acrylic slab. A translucent tinted body refracts a soft backdrop, with a bright fresnel rim, sharp speculars, a thin dark inner edge and a caustic light spill beside it. It is the 2025 'liquid glass' UI look.
BUILD:
- h = heightFromMask(mask, thickness); n = normalsFromHeight.
- Backdrop: a blurred, oversized copy of the logo's own colours (blurCanvas(src, 40)) plus fbm colour blobs from palette roles.
- Body: backdrop sampled at p + n.xy·thickness·1.2 (refraction), mixed with tint at (1 − clarity), alpha 0.45 + 0.4·(1 − clarity).
- Rim: white·(1 − nz)^3.
- Spec: (n·H)^80 for the light angle.
- Inner edge: 1.2 px dark line at insideDistance ≈ 1.5.
- Caustic: a light-coloured copy of the mask shifted along the light direction by thickness·0.6, blurred 6 px, 'lighter' outside the shape.
- Iridescence: hue from the normal angle multiplied into the rim and spec.
- Frosted mode: fbm frost multiplies the body and lowers refraction.
- Bubble mode: round pillow height with thin-film rainbow (hue = h·6).
PARAMS: thickness (8–60 px, 28), tint (color, primary), clarity (0–100%, 60), iridescence (0–100%, 0), light (0–360°, 135), caustic (toggle, true).
PRESETS: Liquid glass, Holo glass (iridescence 80), Frosted (clarity 20), Bubble (thickness 50, iridescence 45).

effects.name: Shattered
effects.brief:
LOOK: the logo printed on glass that has been hit. Shards radiate from an impact point, slightly displaced and tilted, with bright cut edges, dark crack lines, chromatic aberration near the impact and a few falling chips.
BUILD:
- Seeds: Voronoi with a radial bias. Half the seeds lie along 8–14 spokes from the impact, denser near it; the rest are random.
- Each shard: translate away from the impact by gap·(0.3..1)·(1 − d/dmax)^0.5, rotate ±2°, then resample src.
- Shading: per-shard brightness offset ±12%; edge highlight where distance to the cell border < 1.5 px (white 60%) with a dark line 1 px inside it.
- Cracks: 8–14 spoke polylines plus 2 concentric rings near the impact, 1 px.
- Aberration: R/B offsets ∝ aberration·(1 − d/dmax)·4 px.
- Chips: 6–20 small triangles below the logo, rotated.
- Impact 'off' gives cracks only, with an intact silhouette.
PARAMS: impact (select center|top-left|bottom-right|off), shards (10–120, 45), gap (0–30 px, 8), cracks (0–100%, 60), aberration (0–100%, 35), glint (toggle, true).
PRESETS: Broken (Studio 2am), Impact (center, gap 4, cracks 90), Exploded (gap 26, shards 70), Cracked (impact off, gap 0).

effects.name: Reflection
effects.brief:
LOOK: the logo standing on a glossy floor or water with its reflection, or multiplied into a kaleidoscope or mirror split.
BUILD: the source has the logo centred in the SAFE box, so first scale the logo to 0.7 and lift it so the reflection fits.
- floor: a vertically flipped copy below with gap, alpha gradient 0.55 → 0 over the logo height (fade), blur increasing with distance (lerp between the copy and blurCanvas(copy, blur)), plus a thin horizon highlight line in tint.
- water: the floor copy plus horizontal sine displacement with fbm-modulated ripples and darkening.
- kaleido: n-fold rotated copies (segments) at 0.55 scale and 40% alpha behind the full logo.
- split: mirror the left half onto the right.
PARAMS: mode (select floor|water|kaleido|split), fade (0–100%, 60), gap (0–40 px, 6), blur (0–20 px, 4), segments (3–12, 6), tint (color, accent).
PRESETS: Glossy floor, Water, Kaleidoscope, Split mirror.

presets.inspiredBy: Venom Text Distortion Effect, Liquid Text Effects Collection
presets.spec: Add color param tint (default 'primary', with a 'keep logo' toggle) that recolours the melt and drips; glossy highlights plus a faint outer glow in the tint. Preset {melt:85, drips:12, wobble:25, gloss:90, tint:'#7CFF3A'}.

presets.inspiredBy: Melted (Studio 2am: drippy, wavy, stretched)
presets.spec: Add select mode (sag|stretch). Stretch smears the bottom 35–50% of each column straight down (pixel-sort-like, length from fbm). Preset {mode:'stretch', melt:70, drips:0, wobble:15, gloss:40}.

presets.inspiredBy: Ghosted (Studio 2am)
presets.spec: Echo instead of motion: {angle:0, length:18, ghosts:4, lines:0}. Each ghost is also scaled 1.04^k and blurred k·1.5 px; add a 'scale' range (0–20%) if the existing ghost code is translate-only.

presets.inspiredBy: Dunk Text Effect (God Control), Drifter Motion Blur, Motion Blur Style, Acid Motion, Cyberpunk Motion
presets.spec: Add range blur (0–100%): true directional motion blur of the logo (accumulate 16–32 shifted copies along the angle) under a sharp copy, plus a colorA→colorB gradient on the trail and 20% grain. Preset {angle:0, length:80, ghosts:0, lines:0, blur:70}.

effects.name: Neon Chrome
effects.brief:
LOOK: Studio 2am's flagship. Hard-horizon liquid chrome whose environment is a vivid neon gradient map, with hot white speculars, a wide coloured outer glow and gritty imperfections. It must look different from Chrome: saturated and glowing, not silver.
BUILD: reuse chrome.js reflection math (extract its env lookup into a shared helper): heightFromMask(bevel) → normalsFromHeight → reflect a view vector → lookup into a 1-D environment. The environment is a neon LUT above the horizon (e.g. #12002B → #FF2E97 → #FFFFFF at the horizon) and a darker complementary LUT below (#00F0FF → #1B0B4A). Add a Blinn spec (exp 60) in white.
GLOW: dilate mask 4 px → blurMask at r1 = 18 and r2 = 60 px; tint with the gradient's two hottest stops; composite 'lighter' behind, alpha ≤ 0.8, fading to 0 before the edge.
GRAIN: monochrome rng grain ±grain·0.12 on the surface plus 6–12 short scratch streaks.
CYBER / HUD: a dashed contour stroke offset +14 px (traceContours of the dilated mask, setLineDash) and a blurred duplicate behind for depth-of-field.
PARAMS: gradient (select hype|cyber|futurist|synth|team; team builds a saturated LUT from primary/secondary/accent), bevel (8–60 px, 24), glow (0–100%, 60), grain (0–100%, 35), horizon (20–80%, 50), hud (toggle, false).
PRESETS: Hype (pink/cyan), Cyber (cyan/acid green, hud on, glow 75), Futurist (violet/orange, bevel 34), Team neon (team).

effects.name: Glow
inspiredBy: Neo Blur Vintage Text & Logo Effect
effects.brief:
LOOK: dreamy lens bloom and aura around the logo, from soft Pro-Mist diffusion to a big grainy gradient aura (the Divided.co Aura look) to Glow FX's textured pattern halo.
BUILD: keep the logo crisp on top.
- bloom: blurCanvas(logo, radius·0.25) and blurCanvas(logo, radius) screen-blended at strength, with highlights lifted 10%.
- aura: the halo = blurMask(dilateMask(mask, radius·0.3), radius), mapped through a 3-stop LUT (white-hot → color → color2 → transparent) and modulated by low-frequency fbm so it is organic, not circular; add grain inside the halo.
- pattern: the same halo multiplied by a pattern (horizontal lines at 6–10 px, dot grid or grid lines) plus grit noise = Glow FX.
- halftone: the halo converted to round halftone dots (dot size ∝ halo value) in color.
Keep halo alpha at 0 by 92% of S. A slight blur of the logo edge (0.6 px) sells the diffusion.
PARAMS: mode (select bloom|aura|pattern|halftone), radius (10–160 px, 60), strength (0–100%, 55), color (color, secondary), color2 (color, accent), grain (0–100%, 30).
PRESETS: Soft glow (bloom), Aura (aura, radius 110), Glow FX (pattern lines), Halftone glow (halftone).

effects.name: Prism
effects.brief:
LOOK: the logo shot through a crystal prism. Translucent duplicate copies slide off along one direction inside angular facets, each with rainbow dispersion, plus a spectral flare streak. The original logo stays sharp on top.
BUILD: generate 3–7 convex facet wedges (seeded rng lines through the logo bbox centre). For k = 1..copies: transform src by offset·k along angle and scale 1+0.025k; render the copy three times, as R, G and B channels offset ±dispersion·k·3 px perpendicular to the angle; composite with 'lighter' at alpha 0.5/k; clip each copy to its facet (or to the dilated logo hull if facets are off). Draw facet edges as 1 px white lines at 25% inside the hull.
FLARE: a thin band across the logo coloured by a spectrum gradientLUT (red→violet), blurred 6 px, 'lighter', clipped to dilateMask(mask, 30), alpha = flare.
Original logo on top at 100%.
PARAMS: copies (1–5, 3), offset (0–120 px, 40), angle (0–360°, 30), dispersion (0–100%, 50), facets (toggle, true), flare (0–100%, 45).
PRESETS: Prizm (default), Rainbow split (facets off, dispersion 95, copies 2), Crystal (copies 5, offset 16), Light leak (flare 90, warm-shifted spectrum).

effects.name: Fire
effects.brief:
LOOK: the mascot on fire: flame tongues licking up from every upward edge, glowing embers, a hot orange rim on the logo, or soft rising steam. It is a staple of team apparel.
BUILD:
- Source: for each pixel, coverage below = max of mask over the column window [y, y + height] (a running max per column).
- Intensity: I = source·(1 − dy/height)^1.6 × turbulence. Turbulence = fbm sampled at (x·f + warpX, y·f·0.6 + seed) with domain warp, so tongues form and split, then a contrast curve.
- Colour: map I through a LUT (transparent → #3A0000 → #C1121F → #FF7A00 → #FFD60A → #FFFFFF) with alpha = smoothstep(0.08, 0.5, I). 'team' builds the LUT from dark → primary → secondary → white; 'blue' uses a blue LUT.
- Draw the flames behind the logo, then the logo, then a rim: an orange inner glow on top-facing edges (normal.y < −0.3).
- Sparks: 40–200 rng embers above the logo with short upward streaks, 'lighter'.
- Steam: the same field mapped to white/grey at alpha ≤ 0.5 and blurred 8 px.
PARAMS: style (select flame|blue|team|steam), height (40–300 px, 140), turbulence (0–100%, 55), sparks (0–100%, 40), rim (toggle, true).
PRESETS: On fire, Blue flame, Team fire, Steam.

effects.name: Film Burn
inspiredBy: Film Burn / Light Leak Bundle / Light Leaks Overlays / Golden Hour / Old Film Burn / Vintage Light Leaks
effects.brief:
LOOK: the logo on a burnt 35 mm frame. Warm light leaks wash across it, red halation glows at the edges, dust and scratches appear, and optionally a charred burn hole eats one side.
BUILD:
- Leaks: 2–3 large radial gradients (amber #FFB347, orange #FF5E1A, red #C8102E, magenta for prism) from one side, modulated by fbm, composited 'screen' over the logo and clipped to dilateMask(mask, 20).
- Halation: blurMask(mask, 10) tinted #FF3B1F behind, 'lighter', alpha = halation·0.6.
- Dust: rng specks plus 3–8 vertical scratch lines 1 px light at 30%, clipped to the dilated region.
- Burn: an fbm threshold eating the mask from the chosen side, a charred rim (dark 3 px) and a glowing orange edge (2 px, 'lighter').
- Prism leak: a spectral fringe along the leak boundary.
PARAMS: leak (select golden|burn|prism|vhs), strength (0–100%, 60), side (select left|right|top|corner), dust (0–100%, 40), halation (0–100%, 45), burn (toggle, false).
PRESETS: Golden hour, Film burn (burn on), Prism leak, VHS flare.

presets.inspiredBy: Purple Chrome Effect (Kuro), Purple Chrome Text & Logo Effect (Pixelbuddha)
presets.spec: Add finish option 'purple', env ramp #1A0B2E → #7B3FE4 → #E9D8FF with white spec. Preset {finish:'purple', bevel:26, smooth:50, contrast:62, horizon:50, tint:0}.

presets.inspiredBy: Chrome / Liquid Metal Text Effect (gold/rose/gunmetal swaps), Metal Chrome Text & Logo (6 colours)
presets.spec: Add finish 'rose', ramp #3B1F1A → #B76E79 → #F7D7C9. Preset {finish:'rose', bevel:30, smooth:60, contrast:55, horizon:52}.

presets.inspiredBy: Chrome / Liquid Metal Text Effect, Chrome Style Effects Lab
presets.spec: Add finish 'gunmetal', ramp #0E1114 → #4A5560 → #C9D2DA, blue-grey spec. Preset {finish:'gunmetal', bevel:22, smooth:40, contrast:72, horizon:46}.

presets.inspiredBy: Mercury (Ghost Who Walks: 4 depths, 3 grains)
presets.spec: Add range param grain (0–100%, default 0): fine fbm luminance grain plus sparse 1-px micro-scratches, applied after the env lookup. Preset {finish:'silver', bevel:44, smooth:72, contrast:58, grain:45}.

presets.inspiredBy: Iridescent Chrome Text Effect, Holographic Chrome / Chrome Metallic Y2K / Futuristic Chrome (Matsero)
presets.spec: {base:'silver', pattern:'liquid', spread:90, shine:88, sparkle:65, detail:40}. Add a horizon-band contrast boost when shine > 80 so it reads as chrome, not foil.

presets.inspiredBy: The Neon Toolbox, Bayshore Neon Glow Styles, Signal Neon Distortion
presets.spec: Classic warm sign: {width:12, glow:65, colorA:'#FF3B3B', colorB:'#FFD23F', fill:false, flicker:true}.

effects.name: CRT Screen
effects.brief:
LOOK: the logo displayed on a physical screen and photographed: visible subpixels, scanlines, phosphor bloom and slight tube curvature. It must read as a screen, unlike 8-Bit's clean pixel art.
BUILD (≤1024):
1. Curvature: remap coords around the centre with r' = r·(1 + curve·0.25·r²).
2. Downsample the logo to cell-size pixels (box filter).
3. Draw each pixel through a subpixel mask:
- crt: aperture-grille vertical R/G/B stripes, each stripe's intensity = that channel, 1 px gaps, plus a dark scanline every cell row at the scanlines strength.
- arcade: shadow-mask round phosphor dots in a delta triad.
- lcd: monochrome square pixels with a 1 px gap, mapped through the colourway LUT, plus a soft ghost copy offset (+2, +2) at 25% (LCD shadow).
- monitor: fine RGB stripes at half cell.
4. Bloom: blurCanvas(result, cell·1.5) screen at glow, then a horizontal chroma bleed (R shifted +1 px).
5. Optional rolling bright band and rng static.
Alpha = dilated coverage (glow extends past the logo). Bezel toggle: a rounded-rect dark glass panel behind the logo with vignette and glare, still transparent outside.
PARAMS: display (select crt|arcade|lcd|monitor), cell (3–16 px, 6), scanlines (0–100%, 60), glow (0–100%, 55), curve (0–100%, 25), colorway (select logo|green|amber|blue|team), bezel (toggle, false).
PRESETS: CRT Machine (crt, logo), Arcade tube (arcade, cell 8, glow 70), LCD Machine (lcd, green, curve 0), Phone screen (lcd, blue, bezel on).

effects.name: Warp
inspiredBy: Disorder / Status / Wired / Memory Text Distortions
Displacement Map Packs (Scans, Noise, Warp, Bubbles, DLC-001, 12 Free)
effects.brief:
LOOK: displacement-map distortion of the logo, from liquid swirls to smeared drags, bubble lenses and chaotic layered type.
BUILD: per output pixel, p + amount·D(p) → sampleBilinear on RGBA. Cap the displacement so nothing passes 0.06·S from the canvas edge. D by map:
- liquid: two-stage domain-warped fbm vector (Inigo-style q/r warp)
- wave: x += A·sin(2πy/scale + fbm·2)
- smear: along the angle, take the max-alpha sample over a streak length from thresholded fbm, so the logo drags like wet paint
- bubble: Worley cells, each a spherical lens (offset = (p − cellCentre)·(1 − d/R)·k)
- chaos: 3 copies at scales 0.8/1.0/1.25, rotations ±8°, each with its own liquid D, composited multiply/normal with alpha 0.5/0.7/1
Echo: repeat the displaced copy N times with increasing amount and decreasing alpha (Ghosted). Add grain.
PARAMS: map (select liquid|wave|smear|bubble|chaos), amount (0–100%, 45), scale (20–300 px, 120), angle (0–360°, 0), echo (0–4, 0), grain (0–100%, 20).
PRESETS: Liquid (Disorder), Smear (Wired/Memory, angle 0, amount 70), Wave (Status), Chaos (Experimental).

effects.name: Grain Fade
inspiredBy: Recolor - 60 Gradient Maps / GRADED Gradient Maps
Grainy Gradient Textures Pack / Psychedelic Texture Kit
effects.brief:
LOOK: the logo recoloured through a vivid gradient map with heavy grain: organic neon gradients flowing through the shape, or a faded acid look.
KEY: flat logos have no tonal range, so synthesise one first: tone = 0.45·luminance + 0.35·(lit height from heightFromMask at 135°) + 0.3·organic·fbm(large scale, domain-warped); normalise to 0..1.
BUILD: applyGradientMap(tone, LUT) (5-stop maps) → grain (rng ±grain·0.15, applied before quantising so it prints as stipple). Fade lifts blacks (+fade·0.3) and lowers contrast. Halo: a large blurred organic gradient blob behind the logo (Neonic backgrounds), clipped to a soft rounded shape, alpha 0.7. Invert flips the tone. Keep the logo alpha.
PARAMS: map (select neonic|acid|sunset|ice|duotone|team; team = dark → primary → secondary → light), organic (0–100%, 50), grain (0–100%, 45), fade (0–100%, 20), halo (toggle, false), invert (toggle, false).
PRESETS: Neonic (halo on), Acid fade (acid, fade 55), Duotone (team two-stop), Grainy sunset (sunset, grain 70).

effects.name: 1-Bit
inspiredBy: Bitmap Effect - Convert Image into Bitmap
effects.brief:
LOOK: fine 1-bit bitmap dither, like MacPaint or Photoshop Bitmap mode, in one or two inks. It is finer than 8-Bit's chunky pixels and prints as a single screen.
BUILD:
- Tone (flat logos need it): luminance + shading·(lit heightFromMask − 0.5) + an optional fade ramp (linear top→bottom or radial from the centre).
- Downsample by pixel.
- Dither by algorithm: Bayer 8×8 ordered; Floyd–Steinberg; Atkinson (75% error, the Mac look); noise (seeded blue-ish noise threshold); lines (1-D ordered threshold along rows for a line-bitmap look).
- Upscale with nearest neighbour.
- On pixels = ink. Off pixels inside the mask are transparent (the garment shows) or ink2 when backing is on. Outside the mask stays transparent.
PARAMS: algorithm (select atkinson|floyd|bayer|noise|lines), pixel (1–8 px, 2), shading (0–100%, 60), fade (select none|linear|radial), ink (color, dark), backing (toggle, false) with ink2 (color, secondary).
PRESETS: Atkinson, Bayer grid (pixel 3), Floyd fade (linear fade), Duotone (ink primary, backing on, ink2 secondary).

presets.inspiredBy: VHS Tape Text & Logo, VHS Machine, Vintage VHS Tape, Retro VHS Glitch Neon
presets.spec: Add range bleed (0–100%): horizontal chroma smear (box-blur of the R and B channels along x only, ~bleed·0.3 px) plus one bright tracking band. Preset {split:8, slices:3, shift:24, colors:'rgb', scanlines:true, noise:60, bleed:70}.

presets.inspiredBy: Lapse Chromatic Aberration Text Effect, Chromatic Glitch Text, Blurry Glitch
presets.spec: Clean aberration with no tearing: {split:24, slices:0, shift:0, colors:'rgb', scanlines:false, noise:0}.

presets.inspiredBy: Acid Pixel Art Effect, Colorful Pixels Photo Effect
presets.spec: Add palette 'acid': 6 hues (#FF2BD6, #7CFF3A, #00E5FF, #FFE600, #8A2BFF, #FF5A1F) mapped by luminance band with a hue rotation per region. Preset {size:12, palette:'acid', shape:'square', outline:false, dither:true}.

presets.inspiredBy: X-Ray Text Distortion (Divided.co), Neon Negative Photo Effect
presets.spec: Add palette 'xray' #000814 → #0A3A6B → #7FD1FF → #FFFFFF with edges hottest (invert the core weighting so the outline glows and the interior is dim, like bone density). Preset {palette:'xray', spread:40, contrast:70, halo:30, noise:30}.

presets.inspiredBy: Thermal 52 gradient maps (Triad, Heatmap, Fade, Surge), HeatMaps (secret-cache)
presets.spec: Add palettes 'surge' (#0D0221 → #FF1E56 → #FFAC41 → #FFFFFF) and 'triad' (#140B3D → #00B3A4 → #FFE14D). Preset {palette:'surge', spread:90, contrast:60, halo:26, noise:25}.

presets.inspiredBy: Sci-Fi Matrix Photo Effect
presets.spec: Add charset 'katakana' (half-width ｱ–ﾝ plus digits) and a column-rain brightness falloff (each column brightest at a seeded head row). Preset {cell:16, charset:'katakana', color:'fade', ink:'#00FF66', ink2:'#D9FFE6', weight:'bold'}.

effects.name: xScan
effects.brief:
LOOK: the logo dragged across a scanner bed or copied to death. Crunchy black toner, smeared streaks along the drag direction, uneven pressure, drum lines and toner speckle.
BUILD:
1. Toner: luminance of the logo (or posterize(3) when keeping colours) → threshold whose edge is jittered by fbm at 3 scales (±toner·0.25), giving ragged edges, small dropouts and filled-in counters.
2. Drag: low-frequency noise along the cross axis picks drag bands. In those bands out(p) = max over k = 1..L of src(p − k·dir)·(1 − k/L)^1.5, with L up to drag·180 px, so the logo smears into streaks. Add 1–3 'pull jumps' (abrupt row offsets of 6–20 px). Multiply alpha by a 1-D pressure noise along the drag axis.
3. Copier marks: 1–2 px drum lines across the bbox at 15–30% alpha; toner speckle outside edges (rng dots, density ∝ exp(−outsideDistance/12)).
4. Ink: single colour (default dark) or kept colours.
PARAMS: drag (0–100%, 55), direction (select down|right|up|left), toner (0–100%, 60), streaks (0–100%, 35), ink (color, dark), keepColors (toggle, false).
PRESETS: xScan (drag 55), Smear (drag 95, streaks 20), Dead copy (toner 90, drag 15, streaks 70), Color copy (keepColors on, toner 40).

effects.name: Distressed
effects.brief:
LOOK: Studio 2am Distress. A damaged logo combining grain, halftone breakdown and edge distortion at light, medium or heavy damage. It is different from Vintage Print: scuffed and broken, not cracked plastisol.
BUILD:
(a) Edge distortion: displace the mask by an fbm vector field (amp = roughness·6 px) before thresholding.
(b) Erosion: subtract a union of an fbm threshold mask (coverage 5/15/30% by damage), scuff scratches (40–200 random-walk polylines 1–3 px, clustered at 2–3 dominant angles) and speckle holes. Weight erosion toward edges with insideDistance (more loss within 8 px of the edge).
(c) Halftone breakdown: in a second noise region (halftone %), replace solid ink with a 45° round-dot screen whose dot size follows the noise, so ink fades to dots.
(d) Grain: ±8% luminance.
Damage select maps to preset multipliers on all three.
PARAMS: damage (select light|medium|heavy), scratches (0–100%, 50), halftone (0–100%, 40), roughness (0–100%, 45), ink (select logo|mono), color (color, dark; used when mono).
PRESETS: Light, Medium, Heavy, Mono grunge (heavy, mono).

effects.name: Rubber Stamp
inspiredBy: Bold Rubber Stamp Badge Text Effect
effects.brief:
LOOK: the logo inked with a rubber stamp in one ink: uneven pressure, ink-starved texture, pooled edges, an optional badge frame and an optional double hit.
BUILD: coverage = mask × pressure × texture.
- Pressure: a linear tilt across the stamp (random angle, 0.55→1.0) × low-frequency fbm.
- Texture per select:
  - mottled: fbm threshold
  - starved: horizontal striated noise (fbm with x-scale 0.05, y-scale 1) giving streaky dropouts
  - dry: coarse rng grain threshold
  - heavy: near-solid, with ink pooling at edges (insideDistance < 2 px → ×1.3 darker) plus a faint 1–2 px squash halo outside at 20%
- Threshold coverage against a pressure-scaled cutoff.
- Badge: a ring (two concentric circles around the bbox with a 6 px gap) or a double rect, drawn into the mask before the ink pass so it gets the same texture.
- Tilt: rotate the whole stamp.
- Double: a second impression offset 4–10 px at 35% coverage.
- Low-ink banding: sin bands along y with noise phase.
PARAMS: texture (select mottled|starved|dry|heavy), pressure (0–100%, 60), badge (select none|ring|rect), double (toggle, false), tilt (−12–12°, −4), ink (color, primary).
PRESETS: Rubber stamp (mottled), Badge (ring, tilt −6, heavy), Low ink (starved, pressure 35), Double hit (double on, dry).

effects.name: Ink Bleed
effects.brief:
LOOK: ink soaking into absorbent paper. Hairy capillary fringes around every edge, ink pooled darker at the edges, dot grain and slight colour misregistration.
BUILD:
- Fibre field: anisotropic fbm (sample at x·0.08, y·0.02, rotated per region by a slow noise angle) → F ∈ [0, 1].
- Bleed: od = outsideDistance(mask); coverage_out = smoothstep(spread·(0.35 + 0.65·F)·feather, 0, od), which gives fibrous fringes that reach further along fibres.
- Interior pooling: darken by pooling·0.2·exp(−insideDistance/3); mottle with low-frequency fbm.
- Colours: posterize(4) and give each colour region its own misreg offset (seeded 0..misreg px).
- Grain: dot grain multiply.
- 'Ultra ink' adds patchy starvation (fbm holes in centres).
PARAMS: spread (0–40 px, 12), feather (0–100%, 60), pooling (0–100%, 40), misreg (0–12 px, 3), grain (0–100%, 40), ink (select logo|mono).
PRESETS: Bleeder (default), Soak (spread 30, feather 85), Dirty print (misreg 7, grain 70), Ultra ink (pooling 85, patchy, spread 8).

effects.name: Grit
inspiredBy: Print Scanned Textures / Hyper Scanner Textures / Grunge Paper Marks
effects.brief:
LOOK: Studio 2am's texture overlays (fingerprints, scanner dust, folded paper) applied to the logo as knock-outs and tonal shading, so the result stays a transparent, printable graphic.
BUILD:
- fingerprint: 2–5 prints, each an ellipse mask (≈ 70×95 px at 1024) with a ridge pattern sin(r·0.9 + fbm·3 + loop term) → threshold → knock out knockout% of the ink. Smudge: a directional blur of the logo near one print.
- dust: rng specks, 3–8 hairs (thin bezier curves), plus a tonal scan ramp (darken one side by 15%).
- paper: paper-fibre fbm multiply plus speckle knock-out.
- crease: 2–4 fold lines across the bbox, each a light 1.5 px line with a dark line offset 1 px and a slight displacement of the logo across the fold.
- mix: all of them at lower amounts.
Scale multiplies feature size. The tone toggle adds a soft multiply shading.
PARAMS: texture (select fingerprint|dust|paper|crease|mix), amount (0–100%, 50), scale (50–200%, 100), knockout (0–100%, 60), tone (toggle, true).
PRESETS: Fingerprints, Dirty scan, Folded paper (crease), Mixed grit.

presets.inspiredBy: Zine (Studio 2am), Comic Halftone Print, Pop Art Cartoons
presets.spec: Add mode 'cmyk': naive RGB→CMYK split; each plate screened at C15/M75/Y0/K45° with round dots and offset 1–4 px from a seeded rng (misregistration); multiply onto transparent; photocopy grain 15%. Preset {mode:'cmyk', dot:22, angle:15, shape:'round', fade:false}.

presets.inspiredBy: Halftoner (line/wave patterns), Halftone Effects Creator (zig-zags), Halftone Textures Pack (curved)
presets.spec: Add shape options 'wave' (line screen whose centre line follows y + A·sin(2πx/λ), line width ∝ tone) and 'zigzag'. Preset {mode:'mono', dot:20, angle:0, shape:'wave', ink:'primary'}.

presets.inspiredBy: Halftone Spinning Blur Photo Effect
presets.spec: Add shape 'radial': concentric ring line screen centred on the logo bbox, ring width ∝ tone, plus a light rotational smear (5 rotated copies at ±3° with alpha falloff). Preset {mode:'color', dot:24, shape:'radial'}.

presets.inspiredBy: Color Overprint Effect, Overprint Typography Pack, Old Master OverPrint, 20-in-1 Overprint & Ink Bleed
presets.spec: {inkA:'#00A95C', inkB:'#FF48B0', separation:'tone', misreg:18, grain:35, density:92, paper:false}. The wide misreg exposes the multiplied third tone where the inks overlap.

presets.inspiredBy: Retro Risoprint Photo Effect
presets.spec: {inkA:'#FF6C2F', inkB:'#00838A', separation:'tone', misreg:12, grain:95, density:70, paper:true}.

presets.inspiredBy: Retro Book Print, Vintage Postcard Press, Retro Print Photo, Retro Print Texture
presets.spec: {wear:30, crack:40, misreg:3, inks:3, underbase:false}. Optionally add a 'paper' toggle that multiplies a warm paper-fibre tone inside the ink.

presets.inspiredBy: Graffiti Spray Paint Glow Text Effect
presets.spec: Add range glow (0–100%): an airbrushed soft halo in ink2 behind the cut (blurMask of the dilated mask, two radii, speckled with spray dots). Preset {cut:50, ink:'light', under:false, spray:70, grit:30, drips:false, glow:70}.

effects.name: Glitter
effects.brief:
LOOK: glitter heat-transfer vinyl, a real apparel finish. Dense metallic flakes, each catching light differently, a few blowing out to white with 4-point star sparkles.
BUILD: jittered grid of flakes (cell = flake px). Each flake gets a random normal (rng hemisphere), a hexagon/square footprint and a colour = base × (0.3 + 0.7·max(0, n·L)^0.6), plus spec (n·H)^40 in white. With holo, the hue is rotated by atan2(nx, ny)·0.5.
Clip to the mask. Add a 1–1.5 px darker edge so the shape reads, and a subtle raised drop shadow (2 px, 25%).
Stars: for the top 1–3% brightest flakes draw cross sparkles (two thin tapered lines + soft core), length ∝ brightness·sparkle, allowed to extend past the edge.
PARAMS: color (color, secondary), flake (2–12 px, 5), sparkle (0–100%, 60), contrast (0–100%, 55), holo (toggle, false), stars (toggle, true).
PRESETS: Gold glitter (color #D4AF37), Team glitter (secondary), Holo glitter (silver base, holo on), Silver (color #CFD4DA, contrast 70).

effects.name: Frozen
inspiredBy: The Fridge - Text and Logo Effects
effects.brief:
LOOK: the logo frozen solid. Translucent icy body, frost rime on the edges, icicles hanging from bottom edges, internal cracks and bubbles, and a cold glow. 'Freeze out the competition'.
BUILD:
- Body: tone = luminance mixed with heightFromMask → LUT #0B3D6B → #5FB8E6 → #DFF6FF → #FFFFFF, mixed with the original colour at tint%, alpha 0.9.
- Cracks: Voronoi borders at 25% white plus tiny bubble circles.
- Frost: within insideDistance < 10 px, a dendritic fbm threshold (high frequency) in white.
- Spec: from normals.
- Icicles: at contour points with outward normal.y > 0.7, every 10–30 px, a tapered triangle of length 10–60 px·icicles with a gradient and a highlight stripe.
- Glow: blurMask cyan halo at glow%.
- color is the halo/accent tint.
PARAMS: frost (0–100%, 55), icicles (0–100%, 50), tint (0–100%, 30), cracks (0–100%, 40), glow (0–100%, 40), color (color, light).
PRESETS: Frozen, Freezer burn (frost 95), Y2K ice (icicles 0, glossy, tint 10), Team ice (tint 75).

effects.name: Enamel Pin
inspiredBy: Golden Retro Enamel Pin Text Effect
effects.brief:
LOOK: a hard-enamel pin: flat glossy enamel colours separated by raised polished metal lines and a metal rim, with a domed gloss and a drop shadow.
BUILD:
- quantizeToPalette(src, up to 5 palette colours) → regions.
- Metal mask = ring dilateMask(mask, rim) − mask, plus region-boundary lines (pixels whose 3×3 neighbourhood has more than one region) dilated to lines px.
- Metal shading: heightFromMask(metal, 3) → normals → ramp (gold #6B4A12 → #E9C46A → #FFF6D5; silver, black nickel and rose variants) with spec (n·H)^60.
- Enamel: flat colours, darkened 6% within 2 px of the metal walls (soft enamel = recessed, more darkening plus inner shadow).
- Dome: a radial white gradient highlight across the pin, alpha = gloss·0.35, screen.
- Drop shadow: (5, 7) px, blur 5, alpha = shadow.
PARAMS: metal (select gold|silver|black|rose), rim (4–30 px, 12), lines (1–6 px, 3), gloss (0–100%, 55), shadow (0–100%, 50), soft (toggle, false).
PRESETS: Gold pin, Silver pin, Black nickel, Soft enamel.

effects.name: 3-D Pop
effects.brief:
LOOK: a true perspective 3-D extrusion toward a vanishing point (unlike Varsity's flat oblique block). Sides are lit, the face is bevelled, groovy 70s stripes are optional and cinematic steel is a variant.
BUILD:
- Vanishing point VP chosen by vanish relative to the bbox, at ~1.8 S away.
- For i = N..1 (N = 24–60 by quality), slice t = i/N·depth: draw the mask scaled toward VP by (1 − 0.35t) and filled with the side colour shaded by t (darken 0.35·t). Groovy mode alternates side and accent every 3 slices for stripes.
- Face: the original logo, with a bevel highlight from heightFromMask(mask, 6) normals (a light edge line).
- Outline: union of all slices dilated 5 px in dark, behind everything, plus a 2 px face keyline.
- Steel: side slices through a brushed-metal LUT, face as chrome-lite.
- Keep the whole within 0.94 S by shrinking the face if needed.
PARAMS: depth (0–100%, 50), vanish (select below|above|left|right|center), style (select pop|groovy|steel|team), side (color, secondary), outline (toggle, true).
PRESETS: 3-D pop, Groovy (groovy, depth 70), Cinematic steel (steel, below), Team extrude (team).

effects.name: Shrink Wrap
effects.brief:
LOOK: the logo sealed in plastic: crinkled wrap with long creases catching sharp highlights, slight distortion of the print underneath and a faint film extending past the logo with a crisp edge.
BUILD:
- Wrinkle height W = sum of 6–12 random long creases. Each crease is a line across the bbox; its profile is exp(−d²/w²) with w = 6–20 px and sign ±. Add fbm crinkle·0.3.
- Normals from W.
- Wrap region = dilateMask(mask, margin), filled with white film at 8–14% alpha (frosted: 25% plus fbm), with a 1 px light edge.
- Distort: displace the logo by normals.xy·distort·6 px.
- Shade: spec (n·H)^30 in white 'screen' at gloss, and troughs darkened 8%.
- Bubble film: a hex grid of round domes (heightFromMask of circles) instead of creases.
PARAMS: wrinkles (0–100%, 55), gloss (0–100%, 65), margin (0–50 px, 18), distort (0–100%, 35), film (select clear|frosted|bubble).
PRESETS: Shrink wrap, Cling film (fine crinkles), Frosted bag, Bubble wrap.

presets.inspiredBy: Foil-Stamped Paper Logo Mockup, Metal Emboss Logo Effect
presets.spec: Add mode 'foil': deboss height field; the face is mapped through a gold ramp (#5A3E12 → #C9A54A → #FFF1B8) by n·L with a hard spec. Preset {mode:'foil', depth:8, detail:70, light:135, color:'#C9A54A', gloss:85}.

presets.inspiredBy: 12-in-1 Embossed Effects Bundle (stitched leather stamps), Embossed Fabric Logo Mockups
presets.spec: {mode:'deboss', depth:9, detail:55, light:120, color:'dark', gloss:15}. Optionally add a 'material' select (smooth|leather|suede) that modulates the surface with pebbled Worley grain or fine fbm.

presets.inspiredBy: Custom Shape Patch Mockup, Embroidered Patch Mockup, Patch Embroidery Logo Mockup
presets.spec: Add select shape (contour|circle|shield|rect) for the merrowed patch border (shield = rounded top, pointed bottom, fitted to the logo bbox + 12%). Preset {mode:'satin', patch:true, shape:'shield', border:8, patchColor:'primary'}.

presets.inspiredBy: 3D Plush Inflated Alphabet
presets.spec: {puff:40, angle:120, gloss:10, shadow:55, outline:false}. Add a low-amplitude fuzz noise to the normals (fbm at 2 px) so it reads as fabric plush, not plastic.

effects.name: Metal Thorns
effects.brief:
LOOK: a death-metal / bootleg-tee logo. The silhouette sprouts sharp tapered thorns and roots, mostly from top and bottom edges, often mirror-symmetric, finished in flat ink or gothic chrome. It is a huge streetwear trend.
BUILD:
- traceContours(mask), outer contours only. Seed points along them with density; weight the selection by |normal.y|^1.5 so spikes favour top and bottom.
- Each spike: a quadratic-bezier tapered polygon from base width w (6–14 px) to a point at length L·(0.4..1). It bends sideways by curl·L·0.3, and 30% of spikes get a secondary branch at 40–60% length.
- Symmetry: generate for x < centre and mirror across the bbox centre.
- Union spikes with the logo.
- Finish: ink = flat colour with a 2 px dark keyline; chrome = hard-horizon gradient map on heightFromMask(union) with a white spec; blood = red ink with 3–6 drips from bottom spikes.
PARAMS: length (10–120 px, 50), density (0–100%, 50), curl (0–100%, 35), symmetry (toggle, true), finish (select ink|chrome|blood), ink (color, light).
PRESETS: Bootleg (ink, white), Gothic chrome (chrome), Black metal (density 85, length 90, thin), Blood (blood).

effects.name: Angelic Grunge
inspiredBy: Graffiti Spray Paint Glow Text Effect
effects.brief:
LOOK: the 2026 cyber-sigilism look. A cool silver monochrome logo wrapped in thin sweeping sigil/barbed linework, with sprayed edges, a halftone glow behind and faint circuit traces inside.
BUILD:
- Base: gradient map of heightFromMask (bevel 12) through grey #2B2F36 → #C9D1DC → #FFFFFF (tone silver), single ink, or team.
- Sigils: from seeded contour points, emit 6–16 long thin swooshes that follow the contour tangent for 30–60% of their length, then curve outward and taper to hairline (stroke width tapering via segmented lineWidth). Some are mirrored for symmetry.
- Spray: overspray dots outside the edge (density ∝ exp(−od/8)), as in stencil.
- Halftone glow: blurMask(dilated mask, 40) → round halftone dots in color behind.
- Circuit: Manhattan polylines with node dots inside the mask at 25% alpha, in color.
PARAMS: sigils (0–100%, 60), glow (0–100%, 50), circuit (0–100%, 30), spray (0–100%, 40), tone (select silver|ink|team), color (color, accent).
PRESETS: Angelic, Sigil (circuit 0, sigils 85), Cyber (circuit 70, glow 70), Team glow (team).

effects.name: Paper Cutout
effects.brief:
LOOK: the logo cut out of paper and stuck down: hand-scissored white border, paper fibre, a layered drop shadow and masking tape. Collage mode splits it into offset scraps, zine style.
BUILD:
- Border: dilateMask(mask, border) → traceContours → simplifyPolyline(tolerance 6–10 px) for straight scissor facets → fill with paper colour plus fibre fbm.
- torn: displace the contour along its normal with fbm (amp 4 px) and add a white fibrous rim (rng hairs).
- collage: cut the bordered logo with 2–4 random straight lines into scraps; each scrap is translated 3–10 px and rotated ±3°, with different paper tones (light, cream, kraft), and one scrap printed in halftone.
- Shadow: offset (6, 8) px, blur 6, alpha = shadow.
- Tape: 0–4 rectangles (~110×34 px) at scrap edges, beige #E8DCC0 at 70% alpha, fibre noise, zig-zag torn ends.
- Rotate the whole by tilt.
PARAMS: mode (select scissor|torn|collage), border (6–60 px, 22), shadow (0–100%, 45), tape (0–4, 2), paper (color, light), tilt (−10–10°, −3).
PRESETS: Scissor cut, Torn paper, Collage (ransom feel), Taped up (tape 4).

effects.name: Western
effects.brief:
LOOK: a wood-type 'Wanted poster' treatment: a solid fill with a thin light inline, a dark keyline, a hatched offset drop shadow, aged woodgrain and optional ornament stars.
BUILD:
- id = insideDistance(mask). Inline = pixels where id is within 1 px of 0.4·localMax, with localMax approximated as dilateMask of id over 12 px. Paint it light.
- Keyline: 2.5 px dark around the outside.
- Shadow region: mask shifted by depth at 135° minus the dilated mask, filled with 45° stripes (3 px on / 3 off) in color2 or dark.
- Wood: horizontally stretched fbm (x·0.01, y·0.12) thresholded to knock out wood% of the ink in grain streaks.
- Ornaments: 2–3 five-point stars or diamonds centred above and below the bbox.
PARAMS: inline (toggle, true), shadow (0–40 px, 14), hatch (toggle, true), wood (0–100%, 40), color2 (color, accent), ornaments (toggle, false).
PRESETS: Wanted poster, Rodeo (bright, ornaments on), Saloon (wood 80), Clean inline (wood 0, hatch off).

effects.name: Blueprint
effects.brief:
LOOK: the logo as an engineering drawing: crisp light contour linework, dash-dot centre lines, extended construction lines, dimension arrows with measurements, 45° section hatching and a fine grid, optionally on a blueprint panel.
BUILD:
- traceContours → stroke 1.6 px in ink, plus a dashed offset contour at +6 px (hidden line).
- Construction lines: tangent lines at the bbox edges extended 40 px past it.
- Centre lines: dash-dot through the centre, both axes.
- Dimensions: arrows along the top and right of the bbox with labels in a monospace font (e.g. '12.40"' derived from bbox aspect × 12), via fillText at 11 px·scale.
- Hatch: 45° lines every 7 px clipped to the mask at hatch%.
- Grid: 16 px minor and 80 px major lines over the panel or the dilated bbox.
- Panel: a rounded rect in paper with paper noise and a slight vignette; when off, everything stays transparent.
- Use ctx 'final' fonts only from bundled fonts; fall back to a monospace stack.
PARAMS: panel (toggle, true), grid (0–100%, 50), dims (toggle, true), hatch (0–100%, 30), ink (color, light), paper (color, primary).
PRESETS: Blueprint (paper #1F4E8C-ish team-dark), Whiteprint (paper light, ink primary), Schematic (panel off), Draft (hatch 70).

presets.inspiredBy: Graffiti (Studio 2am: 60 tags + distressed overlays)
presets.spec: Add toggle tags: 3–6 procedural handstyle tag scribbles (reuse scribble.js stroke engine, random-walk loops, 6–10 px marker) in dark/accent behind and around the piece, with one distressed buff patch. Preset {fill:'flat', depth:20, drips:60, spray:70, tags:true}.
